name: Idlirvirissong
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Idlirvirissong, hostile sky-house spirit who dances and makes grimaces to bait laughter.
ANATOMY: ONE female supernatural spirit, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, completely opaque Arctic hide garments [idlirvirissong-c02,c04,c09]. HER DEFINING FEATURE is a strongly UPTURNED NOSE WITH BOTH SIDES TURNED UP: a broad tip curls upwards and each side curls upwards, making an unmistakable three-lobed sculptural silhouette. It is her own supernatural facial trait, no costume nose. Strong theatrical painterly stylization, NOT a photographic portrait or ethnic caricature. Asymmetrical uncanny GRIMACE: one eye wide, one narrowed, lips pulled sideways into a tense baiting grimace with ordinary teeth, NO cheerful smile, no modern clown paint or costume.
MOMENT: Stomp one foot forward while lifting the other knee, both arms angled in jerky crooked dance, head thrust toward viewer, staring challengingly as if daring laughter [idlirvirissong-c05,c11]. Face and upturned nose large and clear at 200px.
POWER: No supernatural glow; dangerous test of laughter expressed by confrontational dance only. No victims, entrails or injury [idlirvirissong-c06].
SCALE & CAMERA: Tight full-figure low-angle painterly composition, looming through framing not invented giant size. Face unusually close to viewer due to forward lean, fills upper third.
LIGHT & WEATHER: A single low amber interior lamp illuminates face from below, deep walnut shadows, cold moon edge light at threshold.
SURFACE: weathered opaque hide clothing with rough seams, rough timber, cloud vapor.
SETTING: Her timber house FLOATS HIGH IN THE SKY; show exterior threshold and a broken-open side of the doorway with vast cloudbanks visibly BELOW THE FLOOR and around sill, no ground or trees [idlirvirissong-c05,c09]. Five lean hungry dogs with closed mouths, tucked bellies, angular shoulders, ears alert and eyes watchful crowd the lower side edges, focused on a large EMPTY PLATE beside her feet, qengmerping [idlirvirissong-c02,c05,c06]. No friendly smiling pets. Dogs and plate do not hide spirit legs.
MOOD: Disturbing dangerous clown-like supernatural performance, baiting and hostile, not cheerful. Respectfully original stylized spirit, no realistic ethnic portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoletters, logo, border, watermark, gore or nudity; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no copyrighted film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glowing aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons or floating runes.
depicted_variant: Uncanny female sky spirit baiting laughter through dancing grimaces

visual_requirements.description: Female spirit, nose turned up on sides, clown-like grimaces
Dance baits laughter; lean watchful dogs and empty qengmerping plate, no gore
House plainly in sky above cloudbanks

aura: No generic aura. Presence comes from documented anatomy and action: idlirvirissong-c02, idlirvirissong-c04, idlirvirissong-c09, idlirvirissong-c11, idlirvirissong-c05, idlirvirissong-c06.
artistic_choices: Stylized painterly anatomy makes specific nose readable without photographic ethnic caricature; five dogs represents numerous dogs, not source count.
Opaque hide garment and single lamp are editorial. No supernatural physical effect, no gore.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Self-reject: upturned nose and grotesque grimace insufficiently distinctive at200px; reads ordinary woman dancing.

Redraw so the spirit is unmistakably not an ordinary woman: make the nose that is turned up and flared at both sides (idlirvirissong-c02/c09) a clear, readable trait at 200px. Make the dance an uncanny clown-like performance with grimaces meant to bait laughter (c02/c11), not a cheerful grin, and put her house plainly in the sky, with cloudbanks below or around the threshold (c05/c09). Show the many dogs as lean, hungry and watchful beside the empty plate qengmerping (c05/c06), not as smiling pets. Avoid a photographic ethnic portrait caricature. Keep fully opaque Arctic garments, no entrails, blood or gore, no aura, and no text.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 and200px inspected. Strongly curled up nose with flared raised sides, asymmetrical wide/narrow eyes and crooked tense mouth create uncanny baiting grimace rather than cheerful grin. Jerky raised-knee dance: one head, two eyes, two arms/two legs, opaque hide garments. Five lean closed-mouth watchful dogs beside empty plate; sky cloudbanks explicitly below elevated sill at right. No gore, aura or text. Spirit and face dominate and remain unsettling at200. Seven Sangar checks pass; final independent appraisal belongs to Claude.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and native crops of the face, both hands, belt ornaments, both dog groups and both legs/boots. One female spirit (idlirvirissong-c04): one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs (raised knee with the boot sole thrust at the viewer, other boot planted). Her nose is turned up and flared at both sides into a snout-like shape (c02/c09), legible at 200px. Her grimace is lopsided (one eye wide, one narrowed, lips dragged sideways over clenched teeth) rather than a cheerful grin, an uncanny clownish dance meant to bait laughter (c05/c11), with no modern clown paint or costume. The r02 rejection is answered. Five lean, wolf-like dogs with closed mouths, alert ears and watchful eyes crowd a large EMPTY plate, the qengmerping (c02/c05/c06), with no gore. The cloudbank lies below the threshold under the moon, so the house is plainly in the sky (c05/c09/c11). The drooping left-frame hand shows four digits with the thumb hidden by foreshortening, and the right-frame hand is a curled clawing hand; neither is malformed. Paws plausibly belong to five dogs. The face is a stylised grotesque, not Inuit-coded, and she wears an opaque fur parka: no ethnic caricature. The glass lantern and timber house are editorial, and the bone toggles and pendant carry no lettering. The low camera and looming lean make her threatening at 200px. No text, aura or borrowed design.
